hook: I tried 3 organizers before finding the $17.98 one that fits

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of an empty Hemnes drawer interior, no dividers, socks and folded shirts sliding loosely from side to side as the drawer opens
scenes.on_screen_text: 16" deep. Zero dividers. Nothing fits right.
scenes.voiceover: IKEA ships the Hemnes with zero drawer dividers.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand placing a generic mesh cube organizer into the drawer, camera pans to show a visible gap on both sides
scenes.voiceover: Every organizer I grabbed for a regular dresser either came up short or collapsed.

scenes.visual_prompt: Tape measure laid across the drawer interior, overlay graphic showing 16 1/8 inch depth and 14 5/8 to 30 5/8 inch width range
scenes.voiceover: Hemnes drawers are exactly 16 and an eighth inches deep, every version, but width jumps from 14 to 30 inches.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unboxing and interlocking the Vtopmart clear bin pieces by hand on top of a dresser
scenes.voiceover: This 25-piece clear set is shallow enough to fit, and it interlocks to any width.

scenes.visual_prompt: Fabric bins being placed into the wide bottom drawer, folded sweaters going in
scenes.voiceover: For the 30-inch bottom drawers, fabric bins beat rigid trays.

scenes.visual_prompt: Liner being unrolled and laid flat under the bins before they're placed back in
scenes.voiceover: A non-adhesive liner stops everything from sliding on the lacquered finish.

scenes.visual_prompt: Finished drawer, fully organized, closing smoothly with no rattling
scenes.voiceover: Full comparison's on the blog, link's in bio.

caption: I grabbed the wrong organizer for my Hemnes dresser twice before I actually measured the drawers. Turns out every version — 3-drawer, 6-drawer, 8-drawer — has the exact same 16 1/8-inch depth, but width jumps from 14 to 30 inches drawer to drawer. Three picks under $20 that are actually sized for it, full breakdown and links in the blog post (link in bio). Contains affiliate links.
